internal.title: Incident Report: Frontend Service Error Rate Spike
internal.body:
At 10:50 UTC, an alert was triggered due to a high error rate in the frontend service. Initial diagnosis identified high latency in the frontend and a significant error injection in the checkout service, with error rates reaching 40%. Multiple restart actions for frontend and checkout services were proposed but blocked due to missing dry run approvals. The incident was escalated for further investigation. The root cause is suspected to be related to error injection in the checkout service and frontend latency issues, but recovery has not yet been verified.

Timeline highlights:
- 10:50:38 Alert received
- 11:10:20 Diagnosis round 1: frontend latency
- 11:10:27 Proposal refused: dry run missing
- 11:10:33 Diagnosis round 2: checkout error injection
- 11:10:38 Proposal refused: dry run missing
- 11:10:44 Diagnosis round 3: replan

Next steps include completing dry run approvals and executing service restarts to verify recovery.

external.title: Service Disruption Affecting Checkout and Frontend Performance
external.body: Between 10:50 and 11:15 UTC, some customers experienced issues completing checkout and slower response times on the frontend. Our engineering team identified increased error rates and latency affecting the checkout and frontend services. We are actively working to resolve the issue and restore normal service as quickly as possible. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
